quest.title: Danger Lurks Everywhere in Fontaine
quest.description: You encounter an odd person beside an aquabus line near the Court of Fontaine...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: It can't be... It can't be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Ah! No! I swear I didn't do anything, please don't hurt me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? Why would we want to hurt you?

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: I don't know! But I also don't know that you won't really hurt me!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Oh! ...I've got it! It must be because I discovered your secret, right?

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I... I took the newspaper with your secret letter hidden inside it in the coffee shop?

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Or because I accidentally discovered your passphrase? Wait a moment, could it be that the fish I ate last night...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I say, the reason that the fish had so few bones is because you already deboned that fish!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Yes, yes, you wish to use the difference in the number of bones in each fish to send a message... But I accidentally bought this one and brought it back home with me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the heck is this girl talking about? Paimon can't make heads or tails of it...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Y—You really aren't out to hurt me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with you!? We've only just met you, why would we want to hurt you?

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: R—Really? I'm... I'm glad. And I'm really sorry, how embarrassing...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I've been working hard on a detective novel recently, but I still don't know what methodology the criminal should use to commit their crime!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: And because I am always overthinking things, so... Now when I look at anything, my first reaction is to consider how it could be used to... you know, commit crimes.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: *sigh* That's why I was... so nervous just now. I truly am sorry. Maybe I have become what they call "paranoid" now.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I was about to ride the aquabus into the city for a cup of coffee, but when I saw aquabus running...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I... I immediately saw countless possibilities, all the ways I could be killed on an aquabus! I simply didn't dare to board.

choices.text: You said yourself it was only paranoia.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: That may be so. But I simply cannot stop thinking about it, and the more I think, the more afraid I become...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Really!? Amazing, but... What if the people who want to hurt me hurt you too?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You just try to relax...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Come on, come on! Stop overthinking it. No matter what the problem is, {NICKNAME} can handle it, easy peasy!

choices.text: There's no way that'd happen, stop overthinking it.

talks.objective: Head to the vicinity of the aquabus

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: The aquabus is just over there... We'll board together in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Hey! Why are you crouching on the ground holding your head?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you hit your head or something? But there isn't anything here to hit your head on...

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Shh! Get over here! Lie down next to me! It's dangerous here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we go again...

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: This aquabus doesn't have any kind of barrier on top! If you place two poles on either side, and run fishing line between them...

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Then when the aquabus passes through, that fishing line will suddenly become a knife that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah! Stop! Don't say any more!

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: No, no, you don't even need two poles! One would be enough...

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: And if you hung up some fishing line on it, with the hook just dangling there...

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Then the people on the aquabus would naturally be hooked, and left hanging in the air, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not listening not listening not listening... Paimon's not listening, lalalala!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After listening to her this whole time, even Paimon's getting kinda scared...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get off the aquabus as soon as we arrive at the station, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you hiding again? There's nothing around here!

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Can't you see that Gardemek? It's right in front of us!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Shh! Quick, get out of there! What if it goes out of control?

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Or maybe its... its power core will suddenly explode! Or someone controlling it remotely will use it to attack us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It looks completely normal to me.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: That is exactly what makes me so scared! A meka that is operating normally suddenly losing control, and some poor unfortunate sop suddenly losing their life...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Nobody would even be held responsible for such a thing! Perhaps the true culprit would never be found... No, it's simply too dangerous!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It already left, you can come out now!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Phew... It didn't go out of control, truly unexpected. Our lives have been spared yet again.

choices.text: That kind of accident just isn't possible.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: What I was thinking of, was more of an "intentional accident."

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Wait. But criminal events without a culprit... A crime that no individual will be held solely responsible for...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: That's it! Inspiration has struck! Quickly, quickly, to the café! I must write this down!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Slow down, aren't you worried someone'll toss a rock and trip you or something?

choices.text: It wasn't going to go berserk in the first place, capeesh?

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Ah, right... That's true...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: #Well, thank you, {NICKNAME}. And thank you for escorting me here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You say "escort," but all we did was walk with you here. We didn't do anything!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Yes. It appears I really was overthinking it...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: This coffee is really great, haha... ha...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: ...So, do you think it's poisoned?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Stop saying that kind of baloney! We finished drinking already, and we're fine, right?

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: No, no, no, perhaps it is a... special sort of poisoning.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: First, the poisoner mixes a kind of medicine into our coffee.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Drinking that medicine alone will have no effect whatsoever on the victim.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: After we have finished our poisoned drinks and gone home, the poisoner will follow us...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: And as we sleep, he will enter our room, and mix a second kind of medicine into your water bottle.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: The next day, after you're out and about, you'll take a drink from your water bottle. Then, the two medicines will mix and react within your body.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: And then we'll...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: My dear customer, just what are you saying?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Coffee? Poisoned? Please do not make such jests in my establishment!

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Should your japes affect the other customers, I shall have to ask you to leave!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain Guijarro's situation to Arouet. After listening, he leaves, exasperated...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: By way of apology, Guijarro buys another three cups of coffee...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You watched him make the coffee this time! There's no way there could be a problem with it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Stop imagining things.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: I know, I know, but... I did find a lot of inspiration along the way.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: If I just put it all together, I'm sure I can think of how the perfect crime — one that leaves no trace — could be committed!

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: After I finish writing the book, I'll be sure to send you a copy.

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: But before that, let me finish this cup of coffee, this cup... of coffee...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: #Uh, {NICKNAME}, do you think... Is it at all possible...

response.speaker: Guijarro
response.text: Could this cup itself have poison on it!?

choices.text: Would it kill you not to say things like that for two seconds!?

dialogues.speaker: Guijarro
dialogues.text: Yes, right... that must be it...
